implementation.invalid_input: Missing/blank retains existing 422 behavior. AN/CS/ZZ now produce 422 invalid_input, not_attempted, country_not_in_catalogue with no saved request/options/links. Invalid membership stops before interpretation.
implementation.coverage: XK, AX and BQ are valid members; with the understood synthetic request and CH-only alternative evidence, actual assessed insufficient coverage is saved. CH still saves comparison.
implementation.configuration: Missing, malformed, corrupt, unapproved, wrong-release or changed-data reference returns existing 503 configuration_unavailable; no default substitution or invalid-country assertion.
implementation.server_provenance: interpretation.provenance.reference_versions.country:{source,release,sha256}; server-derived only. Existing payload canonicalization, proof binding and captured request identity are unchanged.
implementation.recovery: Committed store lookup and ownership/payload-bound acknowledgement precede all reference loading and new membership. Test reference is never consulted for unchanged acknowledgement, changed-payload 409 or ownership-first 403. No stale comparison replay.
implementation.locality: Existing 5H unavailable-reference/explicit country-only behavior and independent textual constraints remain unchanged.
implementation.composition: Approved real source-based country reference with explicitly synthetic interpretation and alternative evidence; not a fully synthetic or completed real runtime. Normal app.main remains unconfigured.
